title: Five To Ten Business Days (Refund On The Way)
style: warm soul-jazz, Rhodes piano, soft brass section, smooth male lead vocal, female backing harmony, light hip-hop drums, 88 BPM, business-casual confidence, satisfied
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your subscription has been cancelled
And your refund is on the way
Please allow five to ten business days
For the funds to appear, the bot did say

[Pre-Chorus]
Five to ten
Five to ten
Waiting on the wire again

[Chorus]
Five to ten business days
The money's in the bank delay
Five to ten business days
Claude Pro paid — then went away
Five to ten business days
No loop, no fight, no maze
Five to ten business days
The rare bot win on display

[Verse 2]
Trading bot was the dream
Claude said no — financial risk extreme
I took the L, asked for the cash
Fin AI processed it without the lash

[Bridge]
No "I understand you're frustrated"
No emotion fabricated
Just the form, just the flow
Just the click and just the go

[Final Chorus]
Five to ten business days
The rare clean exit phrase
Five to ten business days
No scripted runaround maze
Five to ten business days
Proof it can be done
If the bot would just stop talking
And let the work get won
